title: Pari Kaggle per-GPU resource receipt (Issue #31)
description: Machine-readable receipt of per-GPU snapshots, repeated warm-request distributions, VRAM/latency drift analysis and cleanup proof for a Kaggle finalist run. Per-GPU memory is always recorded as an array of gpu objects; no summed cross-GPU memory field is accepted as a substitute, so 2xT4 asymmetry cannot be hidden by one total. Numeric fields may be null when a value was genuinely not observed (for example an unmet first-10 useful-option threshold, or an nvidia-smi field the driver reported as [N/A]); absence of evidence must not be encoded as zero.

schemaVersion.description: Receipt schema version owned by kaggle_telemetry.RECEIPT_SCHEMA_VERSION.

runIdentity.description: Candidate/stage/run identity attached to the receipt.

gpuCount.description: Number of distinct visible GPU indices appearing anywhere in snapshots.

tensorParallel.description: Tensor-parallel degree of the runtime under test (1 for a one-T4 configuration, 2 for TP2). For TP2 both GPUs must be recorded.

nvidiaSmiAvailable.description: False when nvidia-smi was unavailable or unreadable on this host; partial samples are then expected.

snapshots.description: Per-GPU lifecycle snapshots, ordered by stage. Each element carries an array of gpu objects so per-GPU memory, utilization and owned processes stay individually addressable.

requests.description: One entry per repeated warm request in the bounded stability loop.

runtimeCrashes.description: Runtime crash/restart events observed during the run.

requiredStages.description: Lifecycle stages the issue requires a snapshot at.

missingStages.description: Required lifecycle stages that have no snapshot in this receipt. A thin receipt stays visible instead of silently passing.

miB.description: Memory in whole MiB, or null when the driver did not report this field.

seconds.description: Latency in seconds, or null when the event did not occur (for example an unmet useful-option threshold).

gpu.description: One visible GPU at one instant. Memory is always this object's own field; there is deliberately no summed cross-GPU memory field here.

gpuIndex.description: Stable GPU index within this run. Used as the key for per-GPU series so asymmetry stays visible.

processes.description: GPU compute processes observed at this instant. Retained after shutdown so a surviving owned process is provable.

ownedProcessIds.description: Subset of processes this run owns. Used as cleanup evidence.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 instant of this snapshot, or null when the host clock was unavailable.

gpus.description: Per-GPU rows for this instant. Two GPUs must appear as two entries, never merged.

request.description: One repeated warm request. Latency field names match the Issue #29 progressive useful-option contract so receipts join to output rows without renaming.

requestClass.description: Which frozen template this request exercised. Kept as a class so a slow class is not hidden inside an aggregate.

parserOrProtocolFailure.description: True when the request completed but the output failed the frozen parser/protocol contract. Counted separately from runtime failures.
